articles.text: CORONEL: Listos, entonces. Un amigo mío va a llevarnos en su carro.
Colonel: Ready then. A friend of mine is going to take us in his car.
JEAN: Con tanto equipaje no vamos a caber todos.
Jean: With so much luggage we’re not all going to fit.
Colonel: Then we’ll make two trips.
Colonel: What’s the matter with you?
JEAN: Me falta la maleta con los regalos.
Jean: I’m missing the suitcase with the gifts.
CORONEL: Debes haberla dejado en la aduana.
Colonel: You must have left it in customs.
JEAN: Puede ser. Voy a ir a buscarla ahí.
Jean: Could be. I’m going to go look for it there.
